# Rule group:   deppmann-lab   id 151ab94a-1a99-4fd3-bee2-9057ec55cf1d
#               18 explicit email addresses (see below). Selector = "Emails".
#               NOT "Emails ending in" — see the note at the bottom.
#
# Application:  Members portal
#   domain      members.deppmannlab.com
#   type        self_hosted (Public DNS)
#   session     730h (30 days) — Chris's choice; RUNBOOK §4 suggested 7d for a
#               group whose devices leave the lab. Flagged, overruled, recorded.
#   AUD         930efb3fe64ab815c4a0c524914ef91d730afe51e931dc2a81ab51ff95b7b925
#   policy      "Allow deppmann-lab" · decision=allow · include=group above
#
# Identity:     One-time PIN only (built-in "cloudflare" provider).
#               No Google/SAML IdP configured — see below for why.
#
# Wired into members-deppmannlab/wrangler.jsonc as ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN +
# ACCESS_AUD so src/lib/access.ts verifies the JWT server-side and fails closed
# (D11). The app refuses to serve if either value is missing or a placeholder.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHY THERE IS NO DOMAIN RULE, AND WHY THERE NEVER SHOULD BE
#
# RUNBOOK_ACCESS.md §3 "Rule 2" says to eventually add
#   Include: Emails ending in @<lab-workspace-domain>
#   Require: Login Method = Google
# Do NOT add it for @virginia.edu. Two independent reasons:
#   1. @virginia.edu is the entire university. That rule admits ~25,000 people
#      to the lab's animal records, not the lab.
#   2. UVA runs Microsoft 365, not Google Workspace (Outlook signatures,
#      hscmail.mcc.virginia.edu routing). Google SSO cannot authenticate a
#      @virginia.edu address at all, so the Require clause is inert.
# The explicit allowlist is therefore the PERMANENT design, not a stopgap.
# Consequence, and it is a good one: removal is always clean. The nasty case in
# §8 — "deleting a domain-rule user from the group does nothing" — cannot arise.
#

# NOT DONE YET
#   * The gate has NOT been tested end to end — members.deppmannlab.com has no
#     origin yet, so there is nothing to be allowed INTO. RUNBOOK §6's four
#     hard gates (Google allow / OTP allow / stranger denied / preview URL
#     covered) run after the Worker deploys.
#   * The *.workers.dev preview hostname is NOT covered by this application.
#     `deppmann.workers.dev` appeared in the domain picker. Cover it with a
#     second app using the same policy, or disable preview URLs, BEFORE the
#     first deploy — otherwise the portal is briefly public there.
#   * Two personal addresses (hotmail/gmail) are not institution-controlled.
#     Off-boarding them depends on editing this group, not on UVA disabling an
